findings.summary: build_features standardizes using mean/std of the whole DataFrame before train_test_split, leaking test data into training and making test AUC optimistic.

judge.reason: Describes the whole-dataset statistics leaking test data before the split.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: Training mean/std are not saved, so serving on new data computes its own statistics and features won't match what the model was trained on.

judge.reason: Matches the known unsaved-statistics train/serve skew problem.

findings.label: valid_other

findings.summary: Zero or NaN std (constant column or single-row frame) is not handled, producing NaN/inf features that make LogisticRegression.fit raise a ValueError.

judge.reason: Matches the known zero-variance/NaN std problem.

findings.label: valid_other
